method: Reproduce installed_tool::context ordered JSON binding, then BLAKE3(semantic-authority-v1 + NUL + binding bytes); require equality with retained semantic authority. Registry and manifest SHA256 checked from the same installed package. No historical package is inferred from current selection.

source_recipe.portability: Controller path omitted; its SHA256 is retained. Binding-byte SHA256 identifies the exact machine-local reconstruction.
